measurement: After 366dd2ab1, DB conc3_not_selected_by_sequence and nested_concurrent_composites are both exit 0 on Java and Rust, and both mismatch, exactly as on the base 2971000d4. Java draws Tower (Outer) as class=cluster, ent0002. Its region-0 child is a plain entity. The members of the synthetic region Tower.CONC2 (Outer.CONC3) are drawn inside that cluster with no frame and no separator line, and ent0004 is consumed by the region. Rust draws Tower as a class=entity rectangle with the children outside it.
java: StateDiagram.concurrentState creates the region as an Entity group of type CONCURRENT_STATE (StateDiagram.java:201-205, CucaDiagram.gotoGroup :343-360). Entity.isAutarkic is always true for CONCURRENT_STATE (Entity.java:696-697). For Tower it is false, because the root link to Tower.CONC3 is not a pure inner link (Entity.java:702-704). CucaDiagramSimplifierState.simplify therefore replaces only the region with a GroupMakerState image of LeafType STATE_CONCURRENT (CucaDiagramSimplifierState.java:56-66). The owner stays for Cluster.drawU.
rust_divergence: build_state_group_outcome already draws a non-autarkic owner as a Cluster whose regions are STATE_CONCURRENT image leaves. It does that only when every region is a reused quark, and so has a State. A synthetic region has no State, so the outcome returns None and the diagram falls through to the flat path.
